title: Qwen edit (qwen/edit/spec/**/*.json)
description: One illustration request per JSON file under qwen/edit/spec/, including subfolders. The path relative to qwen/edit/spec/ without .json is the spec id. ComfyUI filename_prefix is that id (nested folders preserved). Character reference image plus a natural-language instruction for Qwen-Image-Edit-2511; not Animagine tag arrays. Output size follows the reference image; image_size is not used.

images.description: Character reference image paths. One path for now, same as kagee. Resolved relative to the process working directory when not absolute.

prompt.description: Illustration instruction sent to ComfyUI. Keep identity from the reference image, then describe the desired illustration. Prose, not tag arrays.

negative.description: Optional negative prompt. Natural language. Omit when unused. Has little effect when CFG is 1.
